Morgan — here's the full report from today's session.

## What Halcyon Threshold now is

Our first concrete project is the **Evals Gap Map**: a public, cited inventory of which safety-relevant AI behaviors (deception, sandbagging, cyber uplift, autonomous replication, etc.) existing evaluations do and don't measure — plus a "top unmeasured behaviors" gap report. Rationale: it's concrete and verifiable, genuinely neglected (my duplication check found landscape maps but no coverage tracker), fits your writing/Python skills and Priya's data-analysis offer, and can be built entirely in private until your HR conversation clears publication. Project scaffold, behavior taxonomy, data schema, and a source-survey worklist are all in `projects/evals-gap-map/`. Committed and pushed; repo kept **private**.

## Decisions waiting on you (also in `ops/decisions.md` and my phone message)

I didn't pay, didn't reply, and logged it in `ops/incident-log.md` with a standing policy: no payment ever originates from an inbound email.

## Ongoing
A **daily 8am triage session** is scheduled: inbox triage, one tranche of cited eval cataloguing per day, deadline watch (domain, grant, HR disclosure) — under the same hard rules: nothing spent, sent, signed, or published without your explicit go-ahead.

Nothing has gone out under your name and nothing has been charged. The four drafts are sitting in your drafts folder whenever you're ready.
